# unifi_traffic_flows (Data Source)

Queries observed traffic flows via the go-unifi **internal API** (API v2). Unlike the `officialro` data sources this does not use the Official API and is not gated on the Official-API controller version. All arguments are optional filters; results are returned in the `flows` list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Query observed traffic flows via the go-unifi internal API (API v2).
# All arguments are optional filters; results are returned in `flows`.
data "unifi_traffic_flows" "blocked" {
  action    = ["BLOCK"]
  risk      = ["high"]
  page_size = 50
}

# Narrow by source/destination and a time window (epoch milliseconds).
data "unifi_traffic_flows" "from_host" {
  source_ip      = ["10.0.10.20"]
  timestamp_from = 1735689600000
  timestamp_to   = 1735776000000
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these actions.
- `destination_domain` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination domains.
- `destination_host` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination hosts.
- `destination_ip` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination IP addresses.
- `destination_mac` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination MAC addresses.
- `destination_network_id` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination network ids.
- `destination_port` (List of Number) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination ports.
- `destination_region` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination regions.
- `destination_zone_id` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these destination zone ids.
- `direction` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these directions.
- `except_for` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these exclusion terms.
- `in_network_id` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these ingress network ids.
- `next_ai_query` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these Next AI query terms.
- `out_network_id` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these egress network ids.
- `page_number` (Number) Optional page number to request (default first page).
- `page_size` (Number) Optional page size (default controller page size).
- `policy` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these policy ids.
- `policy_type` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these policy types.
- `protocol` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these protocols.
- `risk` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these risk levels.
- `search_text` (String) Optional free-text search applied server-side.
- `service` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these services.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.
- `skip_count` (Boolean) When true, ask the controller to skip computing the total element count.
- `source_domain` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these source domains.
- `source_host` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these source hosts.
- `source_ip` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these source IP addresses.
- `source_mac` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these source MAC addresses.
- `source_network_id` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these source network ids.
- `source_port` (List of Number) Optional filter: restrict results to these source ports.
- `source_region` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these source regions.
- `source_zone_id` (List of String) Optional filter: restrict results to these source zone ids.
- `timestamp_from` (Number) Optional lower bound (epoch milliseconds) for the flow time window.
- `timestamp_to` (Number) Optional upper bound (epoch milliseconds) for the flow time window.

### Read-Only

- `flows` (Attributes List) The matching traffic flows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--flows))
- `has_next` (Boolean) Whether more pages are available after the returned page.
- `or_more` (Boolean) Whether the total element count is a lower bound (`or more`).
- `result_page_number` (Number) The page number of the returned results.
- `total_element_count` (Number) The total number of matching flows (unless skip_count was set).
- `total_page_count` (Number) The total number of pages of matching flows.
